rows.grounds: present passive participle indicating the act of being cut
optative passive expressing potential or actual effect of cutting
compound describing one who has attained that state
compound describing one whose mind is absorbed in that

items.question: Can a person absorbed in that higher state be harmed when physically cut?
premises: A person may be subjected to the act of being cut.
Absorption in that state entails having gone to it and having the mind fixed on it.
Such absorption prevents the cutting from taking effect on the person.
items.inference: One who has attained that state and whose mind is fixed on it is not truly cut even while being cut.
uncertainties: The referent of 'that' (tad) is not specified within this verse and depends on prior context.
items.plain_english: Even while being cut, one who has gone to that state and whose mind is fixed on it is not cut.
